segments.name: Cloud service and solutions
segments.description: Provides integrated public cloud services and customized enterprise cloud and digital solutions to enterprises, public service organizations and healthcare institutions in China.
segments.evidence: The Group provides integrated cloud-based services including cloud computing, storage and delivery.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for cloud computing, storage and delivery usage monthly, for customized enterprise digital solutions, and for post-delivery maintenance and upgrades.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all of the Group's public cloud service revenue is recognized on a monthly basis based on utilization and duration.
